notes: Anthropometrics from the official WHO STEPS fact sheet, Sao Tome and Principe Survey 2008 (measured Step 2, adults 25-64, n=2457): mean BMI males 23.8 kg/m2 (23.3-24.2), females 25.3 kg/m2 (24.5-26.0); obesity (BMI>=30) males 6.6%, females 16.5%, both sexes 11.7%. Old block (F bmi24/ob8, M bmi24.6/ob7) was template-mixed.

Smoking updated to the more recent national STEPS 2019 survey (Pengpid & Peltzer, Front Public Health 2023, secondary analysis of STP_2019_STEPS, adults 25-64): current tobacco use males 18.0% (15.2-21.3), females 4.9% (3.5-6.8), overall 8.8% (7.5-10.4). 2008 fact-sheet comparison: M 9.7 / F 1.7 - male smoking roughly doubled between surveys.
Weights derived from measured mean BMI x anchor height (F 25.3 x 1.58^2 = 63 kg; M 23.8 x 1.70^2 = 69 kg); heights kept at anchor (fact sheets publish BMI only).
WHO GHO API returned no usable rows for ST on 2026-08 (persistent timeouts), so the two national STEPS surveys are the primary sources.

All values from the official WHO 2024 STEPS Fact Sheet Trinidad and Tobago (survey May-Aug 2024, adults 18-69, n=4052, measured Step 2): mean BMI males 26.6 kg/m2 (26.2-27.0), females 28.9 (28.2-29.6); obesity (BMI>=30) males 24.9% (21.5-28.8), females 38.3% (34.4-42.4), both sexes 31.6%; current tobacco smoking males 31.5% (28.6-34.6), females 11.0% (8.9-13.6), overall 21.3%.
Old block was the byte-identical template copy (F162/66/25.3/ob22/smoke8, M174/78/25.9/ob19.4/smoke22) - badly understated Trinidad's measured NCD burden.
Weights derived from measured mean BMI x anchor height (F 28.9 x 1.62^2 = 76 kg; M 26.6 x 1.74^2 = 80 kg); heights kept at anchor (fact sheet publishes BMI and waist, not mean height).
